messages:
jenna-oncall: 🚨 hosted-us-east: sudden fanout from a partner campaign. request queue = 12k and climbing, GPU pool at 98% util. p95 = 6.2s, p99 = 18s. customers seeing timeouts. paging SRE now.

mike-sre: looking. can you paste the latest queue snapshot + active model variants?

jenna-oncall: posting snapshot:```queues.hosted-us-east.total: 12034
queues.hosted-us-east.inflight: 344
gpu.pool.utilization: 98%
autoscaler.attempts: scale +4 (started), scale +8 (failed)
failed_provision_errors: quota_exceeded, rate_limit_rejected```

tanya-platform: deploy-bot says provisioner is rate-limited by cloud provider, creating instances is failing with 429s.

deploy-bot: attempt to create 8 instances -> 429 quota_exceeded from cloud provider. backoff in effect. retry window ~ 6m.

mike-sre: fallback steps from runbook: 1) enable customer-level rate limits 2) failover traffic to lower-cost model variant 3) drop non-essential background requests.

jenna-oncall: starting 1) now — applying soft rate limit for partner-traffic tag (throttle to 30rps)

sam-support: I DM'd top 3 impacted customers and opened ticket, adding note about graceful degradation.

ops-lead: agree do not fail open. start variant-fallback for public tier -> redirect new requests to gpt-small-quantized for non-LL-critical calls. jenna, can you kick the routing change?

jenna-oncall: routing change applied (canary 10% -> 100% over 90s). logs show immediate drop in GPU pressure to 92% and queue decreased 15% in 2m.

infra-bot: autoscaler tried again: scale +6 -> instance-creates throttled (429). Provisioner queue length = 520. Estimated time to recover if cloud quotas lifted: ~12m.

mike-sre: good mitigation, but we need persistent fix. Opening infra ticket to request emergency quota bump with provider. tanya, can you own provider contact?

tanya-platform: on it. contacting account manager now, sent urgent escalation email + phone. ETA for review unknown.

jenna-oncall: observed one error class: downstream inference timeouts (grpc deadline exceeded) — customers hitting client-side retries, contributing to the thundering herd. Suggest disabling aggressive client retries for partner.

sam-support: I pushed a banner to partner workspace asking to pause retries + reduce concurrency for 15m. partner acknowledged and will throttle.

pagerduty-bot: Incident -> P1 created: "hosted-us-east capacity crunch - provisioner throttled by cloud quotas". PagerDuty incident #INC-4821. Oncall: jenna-oncall, SRE: mike-sre.

ops-lead: handoff plan if this persists into next shift: - handoff message in #incidents - include runbook steps + temporary routing config - ensure quota request progress. If provider ETA > 20m, prepare cross-region failover play.

jenna-oncall: documenting mitigations in incident doc: applied customer throttle, enabled variant fallback, paused noncritical background jobs. queue now 6.8k, p95 3.1s, p99 9.6s. still elevated but stable.

mike-sre: monitoring for regressions. adding temporary alert: hosted-us-east.queue > 5k for >2m -> paging.

tanya-platform: provider called back: they acknowledged spike and moved quota request to expedited review. tentative add capacity in 10-15m if approved.

ops-lead: good. if provider cannot add capacity, plan B: ramp cross-region routing to eu/west over 30m and warn customers about increased latency. prep the DNS/edge config now.

jenna-oncall: preparing handoff notes for night oncall: current mitigations, commands to revert variant-fallback, how to rollback partner throttle, links to logs + runbook.

sam-support: customers notified of partial degradation and mitigations. no new support escalations in last 5m.

mike-sre: thanks team. standby on monitoring. will update thread with provider ETA and any scaling attempts.

tanya-platform: provider confirmed quota increase request accepted for expedited handling. watch for instance creation events.

deploy-bot: provisioner created 6 instances successfully at 1758003004. autoscaler state -> converged.

infra-bot: GPU pool util now 65% after new instances joined, queue drained to 1.1k, p95 0.9s p99 2.3s.

jenna-oncall: incident moving to monitor. will do a formal postmortem if we hit >30m P1. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
